name: Painted buckeye
desc: Painted buckeye (Aesculus sylvatica): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 13 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Aesculus sylvatica, the painted buckeye, is a species of shrub. The species has five leaflets that are 4.5 to 6 inches (11 to 15 cm) long and 1.5 to 2.5 inches (3.8 to 6.4 cm) wide.
